title: Kingdom of Bavaria
capsule: The Kingdom of Bavaria was proclaimed on 1 January 1806 when Elector Maximilian IV Joseph elevated himself to king under Napoleon's patronage, joining the Confederation of the Rhine and receiving Franconia and other territories that roughly doubled Bavarian territory. Under the chief minister Maximilian von Montgelas, Bavaria was comprehensively modernized through Napoleonic-era administrative and legal reforms, and Munich was built into a major artistic capital under Ludwig I (r. 1825–1848). Bavaria joined the North German Confederation's successor, the German Empire, in 1871, retaining special privileges including its own army and diplomatic corps; the kingdom continued as a constituent state until the November 1918 revolution deposed Ludwig III and the Wittelsbach dynasty ended 700 years of dynastic rule.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution.
